title: User Manifest (Tier-2 slim)
description: Identity/config manifest for a brain-stem Tier-2 GA install. Instance file: user-manifest.json. Carries the fields the onboarding interview captures (the substitution inputs for the two CLAUDE.md templates plus runtime path/identity fields) plus the runtime hook-threshold extensions. Read-side consumers (hooks/session-start.sh, hooks/prompt-context.sh, lib/paths.sh, skills/librarian/lib/user-manifest-read.sh, install.sh identity substitution) all read with jq '<path> // default' — fields dropped from this slim contract degrade to the consumer's own default; no Tier-2-live consumer validates an instance against this schema. The only write-side validator is onboarding/bootstrap-user-manifest.sh. The `hooks` block carries hooks.memory_review and hooks.context_pressure thresholds.

name.description: Fills {{IDENTITY_NAME}} in both CLAUDE.md templates. Confirmed from `git config --global user.name` in Section A.

email.description: Runtime/identity field. Confirmed from `git config --global user.email` in Section A. Not a template placeholder.

role.description: Fills {{IDENTITY_ROLE}} in the claude-home template. Consolidated from the Section B transcript by the slim extraction pass.

organization.description: Fills {{IDENTITY_ORGANIZATION}} in the claude-home template. Consolidated from Section B; null when the user is independent or leaves it unstated.

paths.description: Filesystem pointers. paths.vault_root is canonical; vault.root mirrors it.

vault_root.description: Fills {{VAULT_ROOT}} in the vault template. Null = no-vault stub (the brain vault is built inline when vault.is_fresh).

plans_root.description: Fills {{PLANS_HOME}} in the vault template. Install resolves to ~/.claude-plans when null.

vault.description: Tier-2 builds a FRESH 'brain' vault inline at install — so there is no is_fresh branch. User cluster folders and vault-specific rules are NOT captured in the interview: clusters are created organically via the runtime propose-and-validate folder flow, and rules are hand-edited into the vault CLAUDE.md's <USER> section.

root.description: Mirror of paths.vault_root (kept for read-API parity).

top_level_folder.description: Fills {{VAULT_TOP_LEVEL_FOLDER}} in the vault template. NOT interview-captured in Tier-2 (clusters are deferred to the runtime folder flow). Set to the brain vault's starter cluster at build time, or substitutes a default; null until then.

behavioral.description: Personal-prose fields, each distilled by the slim extraction pass from the Section B transcript into <=4 tight lines sized for the claude-home template's 60-line cap. Optional; a field is null when the user skipped that prose prompt.

communication_style.description: Fills the claude-home template '## Communication Style' USER section.

working_patterns.description: Fills the claude-home template '## Working Patterns' USER section.

tooling_domain.description: Fills the claude-home template '## Tooling & Domain' USER section.

hooks.description: Runtime hook-threshold overrides. All fields optional; consumers read with jq '<path> // default' and fall back to the documented defaults when absent.

memory_review.description: Memory-review surfacing thresholds + opt-out. Consumed by memory-review-banner.sh (SessionStart), prompt-context.sh (re-firing band), stop-checkpoint-check.sh (high-severity CONFLICT Stop-block yielding to R-26).

enabled.description: Opt-out toggle. Default = true (memory-review surfaces). Set false to silence the banner + mandate + Stop-block. Default behavior is opt-out, not opt-in.

high_severity_pending_days.description: Days a high-severity item may be pending before the re-firing mandate escalates. Default 3.

defer_count_cap.description: defer_count at which an item force-escalates to the re-firing mandate. Default 2.

batch_cap.description: Maximum items surfaced per review pass (anti-fatigue). Default ~20.

auto_suppress_after.description: Number of ignores after which a LOW-severity hygiene finding auto-suppresses + logs a tuning signal. Default 3. Revalidation items are EXEMPT from this 3-strike auto-suppress.

context_pressure.description: R-26 context-pressure loop thresholds. Consumed by prompt-context.sh (warn/mandate bands) + stop-checkpoint-check.sh (48-80% freshness gate / 80-90% existence gate).

hard_pct.description: Stop-block existence-gate threshold (80-90% band; >90% is the always-allow safety valve). Default 80.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York), needed for TZ-aware hooks. Confirmed from `readlink /etc/localtime` in Section A.

created_date.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the manifest was written by bootstrap-user-manifest.sh.

onboarding_complete.description: true once the slim interview has produced this manifest. hooks/session-start.sh reads this flag for the onboarding-resume detect.
